title: Cartservice Replicas 0 (Service Down)
query: There is a failure in the onlineboutique shopping mall. Users report that cart operations are failing. Check the pods and deployments in namespace 'onlineboutique' (e.g. using 'kubectl get pods -n onlineboutique' and 'kubectl get deployments -n onlineboutique') to find why cart operations fail. Identify the root cause component, fault type, and provide evidence.
